codeType.description: Code Type, can be converted to an at-uri by using the reversed first 3 elements of the listId nsid as the at-identifier (authority), so if listId = nl.agroconnect.codelist.fertilizer and content = 7843, the resulting at-uri will be at://codelist.agroconnect.nl/nl.agroconnect.codelist.fertilizer/7843

content.description: Specific code (record key ) from the code list that is referred to by listId.

listId.description: Identifier as namespace identifier (NSID) expression of the standard code list that contains the allowed codes.

added.description: Date / time this entry is added tot the list

deleted.description: Date / time this entry is deleted from the list

scaleFactor.description: Power of 10 exponent to apply to the scaledValue integers value(s) of this object: realValue = value * 10^scaleFactor. E.g. value 125 with scaleFactor -2 is 1.25.

scaledValue.description: Integer representation of a float combined with ScaleFactor

description: Shared types of the AgroConnect codelists
